content.title: Callao, Virginia, the Hometown of the Northern Neck
content.text: Discover CallaoHistoryHistoryHistoryCallao is rich in history - from the invention of the crab pot, to early settlers.ExploreHistoryHistoryTake a road trip, visit a brewery, hitch a ride on a boat - Callao has it all!EatHistoryShopLocal eats, local treats! Callao offers a variety of delicious food.ShopHistoryShopYou do not have to go far to shop local. Callao has a little of everything.Donate to Hometown Community ParkThe Burgess Family and Primis Bank have graciously donated property in Callao to develop Hometown Community Park. Please donate to help develop this park for our citizens and visitors. Community CalendarAre you looking for something fun to do? Check out our Community Calendar!Be Part of the Callao Community.
